## Getting Started

Please join us on the Health Systems Interest Group meeting every other Monday at 10am ET.

The call will be focused on helping those new to the OHDSI community get started with the OMOP CDM. Please bring any and all questions related to OHDSI, OMOP CDM, observational health data and research.

Next meeting: on the first Monday of the month.

See [Get Involved](../community/get-involved.qmd) for the meeting link and other ways to connect with the community.

## New to ETLing your data to the OMOP CDM?

If you're just starting out, [ETL & Mapping Guidance](../etl-mapping/overview.qmd) walks through what ETL to the OMOP CDM involves, EHR-specific extraction guidance, terminology/vocabulary mapping, and the data governance responsibilities that come with handling clinical data.

For the full directory of OHDSI tools and reference material, see [Resources](../resources.qmd).
